pillars.name: 4. Product Offering, Value Holdback & Pricing Wedge
pillars.question: Is it our product offering — did we give away 95% for free, or is the paid deliverable not worth paying for?
pillars.evidence_summary: CORE ENTREPRENEURIAL FOCUS: Visitors use the free tool, yet paid checkouts = 0. We must test the Value Holdback & High-Labor Execution Deliverable (Instant Store & Stripe Failed-Card Leakage Diagnosis + Unmasked Specimen #1 Subject Line & Exit Offer -> $0 email Fix #1 Copy-Paste Checkout Snippet & Payday Retry Window transport -> frictionless one-time passes ($1.99 Single-Store 3-File Patch / $29 Complete Store Recovery Pack / $49 Multi-Store Agency Kit) vs. $99/mo retention SaaS.).
pillars.active_hypothesis: Eliminate the 'Problem Solved Paradox' on AbandonAlpha Checkout & Stripe Declined-Card Recovery Engine (abandonalpha.com): ensure the free step diagnoses & creates sunk-cost customization in <3s, while gating the high-labor execution deliverable behind a $0 functional email transport and frictionless one-time pass ($7/$19/$29).
pillars.falsifiable_test: Engaged tool users click `$0 Email Save` or `One-Time Pass Checkout` instead of copying raw screen text and leaving.
pillars.rule_out_threshold: >= 1 Paid Checkout or >= 5% Checkout Initiation per 20 engaged human visits

pillars.question: Are changes actually live in production and do all interactive/buy buttons work in <500ms?
pillars.evidence_summary: Live production parity & interactive click-through verified.
pillars.active_hypothesis: Ensure 100% of local commits are deployed to live production and every upload/preset/Stripe checkout button responds in <500ms without freezing.
pillars.falsifiable_test: Live production URL returns HTTP 200 and creates a valid `checkout.stripe.com` session in <500ms.
